title: Accessibility statement
description: A working statement of the website accessibility goal, known review process and contact route.
body: This is a working draft statement. The website is designed toward WCAG 2.2 Level AA, including keyboard access, visible focus, semantic structure, labelled forms, clear status messages, sufficient colour contrast, reduced-motion support and reflow on small screens. This wording is a goal, not a certification of conformance. Before the statement is marked approved, representative pages and every form path should be checked with automated tools, keyboard-only use, screen-reader sampling, text zoom and mobile reflow. Any known limitation should be recorded here with a practical alternative and expected review date. People who encounter a barrier may use the monitored public email, phone number or general contact form; Impact Sol. aims to acknowledge feedback within six hours.
